verdict.rationale: The official GitHub README describes ZCode as including a terminal agent alongside the desktop and web interfaces. Running `zcode` with no arguments opens a TUI, and any other arguments go to the agent CLI; the install script puts the runtime in ~/.zcode/runtime and adds a `zcode` command to ~/.local/bin on mac, win and linux (x64 and arm64). An earlier HN thread called ZCode GUI/desktop-only, but that is a perception rather than a hands-on failure of the documented TUI, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the terminal agent works, and detailed docs on the agent CLI's commands and capabilities.
